start: Active workout, default rest 1:30, Bench Press with 3 working sets, sounds on

must_not: The alert naming a set already done

steps.action: Open the card's more button, the rest row, pick '2:00'
Tick a set, then while it runs change the rest to 2:30
user_sees: The running rest gets 30 seconds more

start: Active workout, superset of Bench Press (A) and Row (B)

user_sees: The screen moves to Row, no rest timer
must_not: A rest between the two exercises of one round

user_sees: The rest starts and the screen goes back to Bench Press
must_not: No rest at the end of the round

steps.action: Type 0 min 3 s, then 12 min 0 s, then 1 min 75 s
user_sees: None is taken as a rest length
must_not: A rest under 0:05 or over 10:00 saved

start: Editing a finished workout, or 'Log a past workout'

user_sees: No rest timer and no 'Rest is over' later
must_not: 'Rest is over' ringing 90 seconds after a tick on a past workout
